nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 周六下午，Ruby 发来定位：一家藏在巷子里的咖啡烘焙工作坊。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: You made it! Today we're not just drinking coffee - we're making it. From bean to cup.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: I begged the roaster to let us in. He owes me - I once saved his dog from a very rude seagull.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: A MASSIVE seagull. Melbourne seagulls have no fear and no manners. Respect them.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Nobody has, first time! That's the fun. You'll burn a batch, we'll laugh, we'll try again.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 工作坊里，生豆在滚筒里翻动，渐渐从青绿转为琥珀色，空气里爆开坚果与焦糖的香气。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Listen - hear that crack? That's 'first crack'. It means the beans are waking up. Magic, right?

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Coffee's a bit like language, you know? Same bean, but roast it differently and it tells a whole new story.

options.text: 「Can I try pulling a shot?」（我想试试拉一杯）

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Ha! Don't tell anyone, I have my moments. Usually right before I say something ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Yes! Here - tamp it flat, lock it in, and... watch the honey drip. Oh, that's a beauty!

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你亲手拉出的第一杯 flat white，奶泡上歪歪扭扭画着一片叶子。Ruby 举起手机一通狂拍。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: First latte art and it's a... leaf? A very brave leaf. I'm framing this photo, no arguments.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你们坐在工作坊门口的台阶上，捧着自己烘的咖啡，看巷子里的午后阳光一点点挪动。

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: This is my favourite kind of day. No plan, good coffee, someone to share it with. Cheers to that.

options.text: 「Teach me to surf next?」（下次教我冲浪？）

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Cheers! To brave leaves and rude seagulls. Best city in the world, honestly.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Oh you're ON. Dawn patrol, next weekend. Bring courage and a wetsuit. I'll bring the coffee.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 回去的路上，你手里那杯咖啡早就凉了，可心里却暖暖的。墨尔本的慢时光，正慢慢变成你的日常。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】你和 Ruby 的默契，就像一杯恰到好处的咖啡。
